blocks.text: Mardingtop Hydration Backpack is lightweight, comfortable, and functional, with adjustable straps and breathable air mesh back design. we’ve also added reflective strips to improve visibility during low-light conditions and a safety whistle built into the sternum strap to make explorer easy to spot on the trail. This backpack can be used as a molle tactical backpack, hiking backpack, running backpack, perfect fits men, women in different body types.This is ideal for a casual day hike where you know weather conditions wont change drastically.
Please note that Mardingtop Hydration Backpack Series product is not include water bladder.

Washing & Maintenance Suggestion
 1. Please do not wash with liquid detergent or bleach.
 2. Clean with wet cloth if necessary.
 3. Air dry.
 4. Please do not iron it.

items: Hiking Backpack：25L，This tactical backpack is made of 600D Polyeste，The buckle and zipper are all made of YKK, are a terrific companion for all your day-long or overnight hydration needs

Compact Design：This biking backpack has a compartment and a variety of pockets, It provides ample room for your outdoor essentials including additional clothing, sports towel, maps, etc，The molle system allows you to attach other gears to the pack

Hydration System：The main compartment has a separate water bag compartment for the hydration bladder， It includes a top hole for passing a drinking tube through, suitable for a 2L bladder，WATER BLADDER IS NOT INCLUDED
Customizable Comfort：Adjustable sternum strap, removable hip belt, and breathable bearing system design means this molle biking backpack fits men, women of different body types

Tactical Outdoor Gear：Frees your hands while drinking, this molle tactical hydration pack is suitable for 1–2-day cycling, mountaineering, hiking, climbing, travel, running, camping, exploring, and skiing
